billing_periods_readings_dates.name: billing_periods_readings_dates
billing_periods_readings_dates.value:
"billing_periods"."readings_end" >= "billing_periods"."readings_start"
		AND date_trunc('month', "billing_periods"."readings_start") = make_date("billing_periods"."year", "billing_periods"."month", 1)
		AND date_trunc('month', "billing_periods"."readings_end") = make_date("billing_periods"."year", "billing_periods"."month", 1)

charges_payment_status.name: charges_payment_status
charges_payment_status.value:
("charges"."payment_status" = 'unpaid' AND "charges"."paid_amount" = 0)
		OR ("charges"."payment_status" = 'partially_paid' AND "charges"."paid_amount" > 0 AND "charges"."paid_amount" < "charges"."total")
		OR ("charges"."payment_status" = 'paid' AND "charges"."paid_amount" >= "charges"."total")

hoa_settings_readings_days.name: hoa_settings_readings_days
hoa_settings_readings_days.value: "hoa_settings"."readings_start_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 28 AND "hoa_settings"."readings_end_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 28 AND "hoa_settings"."readings_end_day" >= "hoa_settings"."readings_start_day"

works_time_range.name: works_time_range
works_time_range.value: "works"."time_end" IS NULL OR "works"."time_start" IS NULL OR "works"."time_end" > "works"."time_start"

works_done_has_report.name: works_done_has_report
works_done_has_report.value: "works"."status" <> 'done' OR ("works"."report" IS NOT NULL AND "works"."completed_on" IS NOT NULL)
